entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Gajendra Singh

On The 10th Of July, 2025
 Criminal Revision No. 4903 of 2019
 Prakashchandra
 Versus
The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others

Appearance:
 Mr. Satish Chandra Shirvastava, counsel for the applica
 Mr. Rajendra Suryawanshi, public prosecutor for the non
 applicant/State.
 Order

Applicant has preferred the criminal revision being aggrieved by order dated 11.09.2019 in Sessions Trial No.73/2018 passed by 27th Additional Sessions Judge, Indore, whereby the charges under Section 120 467/120-B, 468/120-B, 471/120-B, 465/120-B, 420/120-B and Section 218 of IPC have been framed against the applicant.

Counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has already suffered jail incarceration of more than five years and the witnesses namely; Anil (PW/1) and Dhulichand (PW/2) have been examined and thereafter no other witnesses have been examined and a limited prayer has been made before the trial court to conclude the trial as early as possible.
Time cannot be fixed for conclusion of trial but speedy trial is a right of accused/applicant.
The p r o c e e d i n g s m a d e a v a i l a b l e f o r p e r u s a l d i s c l o s e s N E U T R A L C I T A T I O N N O .
2025:MPHC-IND:17586 2 CRR-4903-2019 that witnesses have not been examined yet by the prosecution for no good reason.
This case is arising out of Crime No.351/2003 of Police-Station - Sanwer, District - Indore (MP).

Accordingly, the Incharge of Police-Station - Sanwer, District - Indore is directed to ensure that the witnesses are present before the trial court on the date as fixed by the trial court and the Incharge
shall depute Special Officer for ensuring the presence of witnesses before the learned trial court.
A copy of this order be forwarded to the Incharge, Police- Station - Sanwer, District - Indore, for perusal and compliance.
The trial court is requested to expedite the trial/proceedings, as early as possible.
With the aforesaid direction, the present criminal revision stands disposed of.
